title: Padres @ Brewers
summary: Padres bring the cleaner multi-layer case, with the market, listed starter shape, standings profile, and bullpen follow-through all leaning their way at American Family Field.
lean: Lean Padres if the cleaner starter-to-bullpen chain and standings profile still hold once the late innings start to matter.
factors: Current board: Padres +109 / Brewers -131 | O8.5 (-118) / U8.5 (-102) | Padres +1.5 (-186) / Brewers -1.5 (+153).
Brandon Sproat enters with the softer ERA baseline, so early traffic could flip the whole script quickly.
Padres enter 24-16, division leader, +3 RD; Brewers enter 22-16, 2nd in division, +54 RD.
Padres offense: 7.30 H/G with 3.33 over the last three; Brewers offense: 8.03 H/G with 6.33 over the last three.
Padres bullpen: 3.50 ERA and 1.17 WHIP; Brewers bullpen: 3.43 ERA and 1.34 WHIP.
swingFactor: Swing factor: whether Padres can keep the game live long enough to stop Rodriguez from dictating the entire pace.
